signal: Celigo was named the only 2025 Gartner Peer Insights Customers' Choice for iPaaS and ranked #1 in G2's Summer 2025 Grid, while expanding its executive team around AI-enabled automation.

email.body1:
Kristin, saw Celigo take the only 2025 Gartner Peer Insights Customers' Choice for iPaaS and the #1 G2 spot.

Recognition like that usually generates more in-market accounts than the team can cover before the interest cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Celigo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kristin, quick follow-up for Celigo.

After strong analyst and peer recognition, pipeline expectations tend to climb faster than headcount, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Celigo needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kristin, last bit of proof for Celigo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Celigo's reply rate likely compares to other integration and automation companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kristin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Capitalizing on big analyst wins keeps the revenue marketing team busy for a while.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue motion? I'll tailor it to Celigo either way.
